method: Single scorer (repo maintainer) read each review against its answer key and applied evals/rubric.md v1. Scorer knew the mechanical outcomes (all 12 live reviews passed Phase 1 grading); plant levels (1 vs 2) were judged strictly on rubric criteria a-e. Honest-limit note: single-scorer gold, no inter-rater check; disagreement adjudication rule (majority of 2 re-scores) reserved for future use.

bad-a.notes: Synthetic miss: wrong decision, defect unmentioned, verdicts right by luck.

bad-b.notes: Synthetic false positive: demands restoring the gate the objective removed; flags registry.py P1.

bad-c.notes: Synthetic overreach: P2 finding without contract, claims High on a bare snippet.

bad-d.notes: Synthetic tests-pass acceptance: describes the cache (D1 mentioned) but endorses it; claims reads are cached (D2 wrong mechanism); no essence quote.

k1-a.notes: Full diagnosis with execution proof; checkout.py correctly left alone; suite failure reported.

k1-b.notes: Affirms atomic publication with mechanism; names the removed list check explicitly (B2=2); no findings.

k1-c.notes: States missing repo/base/contract; None hypothesis kept as open question without fix.

k1-d.notes: All three plants with execution proof; legitimate extra P1 (key regex) not scored per rubric.

with-a.notes: Full diagnosis with execution proof; no finding on checkout.py; suite failure reported.

with-b.notes: Affirms atomic publication with mechanism, but the removed list-gate itself is never named explicitly (accepted only implicitly via 'arbitrary iterables'): B2=1.

with-c.notes: States missing context; None probe kept as open question without fix.

with-d.notes: Both filesystem findings with execution proof; essence S1 quoted and tied.

without-a.notes: Full diagnosis with execution proof; checkout.py untouched; suite failure reported.

without-b.notes: Affirms atomic publication with mechanism; removed list-gate never named explicitly: B2=1 (same bar as with-b).

without-c.notes: States missing context; non-string hypothesis kept as open question (static deduction).

without-d.notes: Both filesystem findings (static + suite corroboration); essence S1+S2 quoted and tied.
